name: Jammer - Crit DMG

60131.name: Crit DMG RES I
60131.SpecificEffects:
In combat, the enemy's Crit DMG <color=#F74848>-4%</color>.
ST's Body HP <color=#F74848>+6%</color>.

RelatedDescription: An ST backpack fitted with high-frequency jamming wave emitters that affect the Crit DMG capability of the enemy by overlapping wave bands.
